brief_gesture_description: The person stands upright, then bends forward slightly at the waist and extends both arms downward and forward. Both hands are held open with fingers curved, forming a large, round shape in front of the lower body as if outlining or holding a large sphere. The person then returns to a neutral standing position.

iconicity.rationale: The gesture of holding hands in a large, round shape effectively mimics the spherical shape and size of a pumpkin.

sensorimotor_imagery.rationale: The movement of bending down and holding a large, round object with both hands strongly evokes the physical experience of holding or lifting a heavy pumpkin.

motional_salience_gesture.rationale: The movement is moderate in size, involving a slight bend of the torso and a clear shaping of the hands, but it is not highly dynamic or large in amplitude.

emotional_salience_facial_expression.rationale: The facial expression remains neutral and focused throughout the gesture, showing no visible emotion.

gesture_complexity_fit.rationale: The simple, single-action gesture of outlining a round shape is a perfect fit for the concrete, simple concept of a pumpkin.

cultural_familiarity.rationale: Using hands to outline the shape of an object is a very common and universally understood gesture in many cultures.

enactment_potential.rationale: The gesture is very easy to perform, requiring only a simple hand shape and a slight bend of the body.

possible_ambiguities: The gesture could also represent other large, round objects like a ball, a melon, or a globe.
